verses.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਬਲ
verses.translit_en: achhal achhedh prabh jaa kai bas bisavai bal

en.bdb: (A seeker woman asks her spiritual love-drenched friends.)

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜੁ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਕੀਏ ਕਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tai ju ras bas ke'ee kavan prakaar kai ||

en.bdb: O friend! that Transcendent one who cannot be deceived by anyone. He is unbreakable who with His power has subdued the whole world, With what elixir have you been able to enamor Him?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਆਲੀ ਕਵਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: siv sanakaadh brahamaadhik na dhiaan paavai tero dhiaan dhaarai aalee kavan si(n)gaar kai ||

en.bdb: O friend! He who has not even been realised by Sanak, Sananadan and those who have contemplated on Brahma, what embellishments and adornments have attracted Him to you?

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੇਖ ਜੰਪਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਸ ਗਾਵਤ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nigam asa(n)kh sekh ja(n)pat hai jaa ko jas tero jas gaavat kavan upakaar kai ||

en.bdb: O friend! the Lord whose praise is being said in different words by Vedas and Sheshnag, what merits have made Him sing your praise?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਹਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਨ ਖੋਜ ਪਾਵੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਪਿਆਰ ਕੈ ॥੬੪੭॥
verses.translit_en: sur nar naath jaeh khojat na khoj paavai khojat firat toh kavan piaar kai ||647||

en.bdb: God who has not been realised by gods, man and Naths who have laboured untiringly, what type of love has made Him search you?  (647)
